links.comparator_used: Same models (GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4o, o1-preview) without RAG, relying on training knowledge alone
links.outcome: Overall accuracy on the 2024 Japanese Orthopedic Specialist Examination
links.effect: GPT-3.5 Turbo 29% without RAG vs 28% with RAG; GPT-4o 62% to 72%; o1-preview 67% to 84%
links.tradeoff: GPT-3.5 Turbo mainly failed to apply the retrieved data. GPT-4o and o1-preview still erred when the database lacked relevant information or on image-based questions.
links.quote: GPT-4o rose from 62 % to 72 %, while o1-preview increased from 67 % to 84 %.
